mapper.select: SELECT item_stock_history.id AS id, item_stock_history.stock_history_id AS stockHistoryId, item_stock_history.stock_before AS stockBefore, item_stock_history.amount_change AS amountChange, item_stock_history.stock_after AS stockAfter, storage.name AS storageName, stock_history.created_at AS createdAt, user.name AS operatorName, stock_history.type AS type, stock_history.amount AS amount, stock_history.remark AS remark FROM item_stock_history LEFT JOIN stock_history ON item_stock_history.stock_history_id = stock_history.id LEFT JOIN storage ON stock_history.storage_id = storage.id LEFT JOIN user ON stock_history.created_by = user.id WHERE item_stock_history.item_id = #{itemId} ORDER BY stock_history.created_at DESC, stock_history.id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO item_stock_history (stock_history_id, item_id, stock_before, amount_change, stock_after) VALUES (#{adjustmentId}, #{itemId}, #{stockBefore}, #{amountChange}, #{stockAfter})
